verdict.rationale: Close is a SaaS CRM, so headless operation means driving it through its first-party REST API. API keys are documented as 'Best for scripts, internal tools, and server-side integrations', and there is a published OpenAPI spec plus programmatic workflow and bulk-action endpoints, so it can be automated without the UI. There is no CLI, no CI-specific guidance and no hands-on corroboration of pipeline use. Missing for 10: official CLI or headless runner, CI/CD integration docs, documented non-interactive auth patterns for pipelines, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: API Keys — Best for scripts, internal tools, and server-side integrations
Manage workflows with sequences or bulk actions, or send email/SMS programmatically.
We publish an OpenAPI spec at: https://api.close.com/api/openapi.json
API keys can be created and managed in your Close account under Settings → Developer → API Keys.
